cards.ex: He crossed his arms, which made him look defensive.
cards.exUz: U qo'llarini chalishtirdi, bu uni himoyalanayotgandek ko'rsatdi.
cards.uzDef: Qo'llarni ko'krak qismida bir-biriga chalishtirib qo'yish.

cards.ex: She rolled her eyes when he started talking about politics.
cards.exUz: U siyosat haqida gapira boshlaganida ko'zlarini pirpiratdi.
cards.uzDef: Ko'zlarni yuqoriga aylantirib, norozilikni bildirish.

cards.ex: I shrugged my shoulders; I had no idea what he was talking about.
cards.exUz: Men yelkamni qisdim; uning nima haqida gapirayotganini bilmasdim.
cards.uzDef: Bilmaslik yoki befarqlikni ko'rsatish uchun yelkalarni ko'tarish.

cards.ex: He started tapping his foot impatiently while waiting in line.
cards.exUz: U navbatda turganida sabrsizlik bilan oyog'ini taqillata boshladi.
cards.uzDef: Oyoqni yerga urib, asabiylik yoki zerikishni ko'rsatish.

cards.ex: I gave him a thumbs up to show I agreed with his idea.
cards.exUz: Men uning g'oyasiga rozi ekanligimni ko'rsatish uchun unga qo'limni ko'tarib ma'qulladim.
cards.uzDef: Qo'lning bosh barmog'ini yuqoriga ko'tarib, ma'qullashni bildirish.

cards.ex: She nodded her head in agreement with what I was saying.
cards.exUz: U men aytayotgan gapga rozi bo'lgani uchun boshini irg'atdi.
cards.uzDef: Rozilik, tushunish yoki salomlashish uchun boshni pastga tushirib, keyin ko'tarish.

cards.ex: He shook his head when I asked if he wanted to go.
cards.exUz: Men uning borishni xohlashini so'raganimda, u boshini chayqadi.
cards.uzDef: Rad etish, norozilik yoki tushunmaslikni ko'rsatish uchun boshni yon tomonga harakatlantirish.

cards.ex: She bites her nails whenever she's nervous about something.
cards.exUz: U har safar biror narsadan asabiylashsa, tirnoqlarini tishlaydi.
cards.uzDef: Asabiylik yoki stressni ko'rsatish uchun tirnoqlarni tishlash.

cards.ex: He raised his eyebrows when he heard the surprising news.
cards.exUz: U hayratlanarli xabarni eshitgach, qoshlarini ko'tardi.
cards.uzDef: Ajablanish, shubha yoki qiziqishni bildirish uchun qoshlarni yuqoriga ko'tarish.

cards.ex: He clenched his fists, trying to control his anger.
cards.exUz: U g'azabini nazorat qilishga harakat qilib, mushtlarini tugdi.
cards.uzDef: G'azab yoki qat'iyatlilikni ko'rsatish uchun barmoqlarni kaftga qarab siqish.

cards.ex: She just gave me a blank stare when I told her the joke.
cards.exUz: Men unga hazilni aytdim, lekin u menga shunchaki bo'sh nigoh bilan qaradi.
cards.uzDef: Hech qanday his-tuyg'uni ifodalamaydigan ko'rinish.

cards.ex: You can often tell what someone is feeling through their body language.
cards.exUz: Odatda odamning his-tuyg'ularini uning tana tili orqali bilib olishingiz mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Hissiyot va fikrlarni tana harakatlari orqali ifodalash.

cards.ex: She folded her arms and waited for an explanation.
cards.exUz: U qo'llarini bukib, izoh kutdi.
cards.uzDef: Qo'llarni ko'krak qismida bir-biriga bog'lash.

cards.ex: It's important to make eye contact during a job interview.
cards.exUz: Ish suhbatida ko'z bilan aloqa qilish muhim.
cards.uzDef: Boshqa odamning ko'zlariga qarash.

cards.ex: They exchanged a knowing glance, and I knew they were planning something.
cards.exUz: Ular ma'noli qarash bilan almashdilar va men ularning nimadir rejalashtirayotganini bildim.
cards.uzDef: Sirlilik yoki umumiy tushunchani aks ettiruvchi qarash.

cards.ex: He was tapping his fingers on the table, clearly impatient.
cards.exUz: U aniq sabrsizlanib, stol ustiga barmoqlarini taqillatardi.
cards.uzDef: Asabiylik yoki zerikishni ko'rsatish uchun barmoqlarni sirtga urish.

cards.ex: She bit her lip, trying not to laugh.
cards.exUz: U kulmaslikka harakat qilib, labini tishladi.
cards.uzDef: Hayajon, asabiylik yoki diqqatni jamlashga harakat qilishni ko'rsatish uchun labni tishlash.

cards.ex: She had a furrowed brow as she read the complicated instructions.
cards.exUz: U murakkab ko'rsatmalarni o'qiyotganda qovog'i solingan edi.
cards.uzDef: O'ylash, tashvishlanish yoki chalkashlikni ko'rsatadigan qoshlarning holati.

cards.ex: I waved my hand to get his attention.
cards.exUz: Men uning e'tiborini tortish uchun qo'limni silkitdim.
cards.uzDef: Salomlashish yoki xayrlashish uchun qo'lni harakatlantirish.

cards.ex: She's been giving me the cold shoulder ever since our argument.
cards.exUz: Bizning janjalimizdan beri u menga e'tibor bermayapti.
cards.uzDef: Odamga sovuq munosabatda bo'lish, unga e'tibor bermaslik.

cards.ex: I can read him like a book; I know exactly what he's thinking.
cards.exUz: Men uni kitobdek o'qiy olaman; uning nima haqida o'ylayotganini aniq bilaman.
cards.uzDef: Odamning his-tuyg'ularini va niyatlarini oson tushunish.

cards.ex: He made a dismissive gesture with his hand, indicating he wasn't interested.
cards.exUz: U qo'li bilan rad etuvchi imo-ishora qildi va o'zining qiziqmasligini bildirdi.
cards.uzDef: Rad etish yoki ahamiyat bermaslikni ko'rsatadigan imo-ishora.

cards.ex: Even though she was nervous, she tried to stand tall and look confident.
cards.exUz: U asabiylashgan bo'lsa ham, u tik turishga va o'ziga ishonchli ko'rinishga harakat qildi.
cards.uzDef: O'ziga ishonchni ko'rsatish uchun to'g'ri turmoq.

cards.ex: He slouched down in his chair, looking bored.
cards.exUz: U zerikib, stulida bukilib o'tirdi.
cards.uzDef: Ishonchsizlik, zerikish yoki xavotirlikni ko'rsatib, egilib o'tirish.

cards.ex: It was difficult to maintain composure after hearing the bad news.
cards.exUz: Yomon xabarni eshitgandan so'ng, o'zini tutish qiyin edi.
cards.uzDef: O'zingizni xotirjam va nazorat ostida ushlab turish.

cards.ex: She looked at the fireworks wide-eyed with amazement.
cards.exUz: U olov otashinlariga hayratdan kattakon ko'zlari bilan qaradi.
cards.uzDef: Hayrat, qo'rquv yoki hayajonni ko'rsatuvchi ko'zlar.

cards.ex: She greeted me with a warm smile, making me feel welcome.
cards.exUz: U meni iliq tabassum bilan kutib oldi va o'zimni xush qarshi olgandek his qildim.
cards.uzDef: Do'stona va samimiy tabassum.

cards.ex: He avoided eye contact because he was lying.
cards.exUz: U yolg'on gapirayotgani uchun ko'zdan qochdi.
cards.uzDef: Boshqa odamning ko'zlariga qaramaslik.

cards.ex: The kids were fidgeting around, waiting for the movie to start.
cards.exUz: Bolalar kinoning boshlanishini kutib, qimirlab turishardi.
cards.uzDef: Asabiylik, zerikish yoki xavotirlik tufayli tinimsiz harakatlanish.

cards.ex: She pursed her lips when she disagreed with his suggestion.
cards.exUz: U uning taklifiga rozi bo'lmaganida labini burishtirdi.
cards.uzDef: Norozilik, o'ylash yoki asabiylikni ko'rsatish uchun lablarni qisish.
